sources.entry: Bitpoll - Conduct polls about dates, times or general questions. (Demo) GPL-3.0 Docker/Python

summary.one_liner: Bitpoll is a self-hostable web app for running polls about dates, times, or general questions, rewritten in Django from the earlier Dudel project.
summary.what_it_does: Bitpoll lets you create polls for scheduling dates and times or for general questions. Poll creators can choose whether votes are anonymous or require a name, and whether voting requires registration. Private events can be restricted to invited people only. Polls can cover a full day or just a few hours, and custom classes can be defined. Poll URLs can be set manually or generated randomly. The backend is built on the Django framework.
use_cases: schedule a meeting time with a group
find a date that suits everyone
how_to_run: wget -O run/config/settings.py (example settings file; URL not given in README), then adapt database settings, secret key, and allowed hosts
docker run -a stdout -a stderr --rm --name bitpoll -p 3008:3008 -p 3009:3009 --volume ./run/static:/opt/static --volume ./run/config:/opt/config ghcr.io/fsinfuhh/bitpoll
git clone (repository URL not given in README), then uv sync --group dev
copy bitpoll/settings_local.sample.py to bitpoll/settings_local.py, then ./manage.py migrate and ./manage.py runserver
notable: Anonymous voting or name-required voting, selectable per poll
Private events visible only to invited people
Full-day or short-time-slot polls with custom classes
Official Docker image built from master on ghcr.io
caveats: Production setup requires several system packages (g++, libldap2-dev, libsasl2-dev, etc.) and running compilemessages and collectstatic
Manual install needs uv and a settings_local.py file configured before use
README is a fork-style rewrite of Dudel; demo and GUI screenshots are referenced but not included in the text
keywords: schedule a meeting with a group
